latest_release.name: slate-react@0.147.6
latest_release.body:
### Patch Changes

- [#6364](https://github.com/ianstormtaylor/slate/pull/6364) [`6f00413`](https://github.com/ianstormtaylor/slate/commit/6f004138c4b1ab48949352de53713628407d1165) Thanks [@dannelundqvist](https://github.com/dannelundqvist)! - Copy and cut now use the selection the user just made. Selection changes reach `editor.selection` a little later than they happen, and copy and cut wrote the clipboard from `editor.selection`, so a copy straight after selecting, such as Ctrl+A followed at once by Ctrl+C, could copy the previous selection or nothing at all. Copy and cut now process any pending selection change first, before an `onCopy` or `onCut` handler runs.
